html.Decidimos llamarnos Zulu porque así nos: We chose the name Zulu because that's what the people who know us call us, and that same closeness is what we want you to feel. We offer warm, friendly advice, like talking to a friend who knows real estate — we want working with us to be a pleasant experience from start to finish.
html.Te asesoramos en Antioquia, que es donde: We advise you in Antioquia, where we mainly work, drawing on the experience our father has passed on to us. We accompany your investment with the best intentions, until you find what you're looking for, and with the peace of mind that your savings will be invested the right way.

html.No. Conversar con nosotros, entender qué: No. Talking with us, understanding what you're looking for and receiving the first options is free of charge.

html.Sí. Acompañamos el proceso completo a di: Yes. We support the whole process remotely, with video calls, videos of the visits and help with the legal side.

lote-222-montesereno-el-retiro.descripcion_corta: Corner lot of 3,562 m² in Montesereno, with double frontage on an internal road, an existing leveled pad and native forest along the upper boundary.

finca-el-rincon-santa-fe-de-antioquia.titulo: Finca El Rincón — Santa Fe de Antioquia
finca-el-rincon-santa-fe-de-antioquia.descripcion_corta: Traditional Antioquian-style country house in the Hato Obregón gated community, surrounded by fruit trees and wide gardens, with its own 14x7 m pool, 68 km from Medellín on the Bolombolo road.

lote-pontezuela-la-ceja.descripcion_corta: Country lot of 8,900 m² in the Pontezuela area, across from the Pan Comido bakery, with wide flat grassy areas, native trees, living fences and open views of the Eastern Antioquia mountains.

oficina-indiana-mall-alto-de-las-palmas-.titulo: Indiana Mall Office — Alto de las Palmas, Envigado
oficina-indiana-mall-alto-de-las-palmas-.descripcion_corta: Two-level office with a large window onto the greenery, wood-look laminate flooring, built-in kitchen with pantry and recessed lighting, in the Indiana Mall at Alto de las Palmas.

oficina-q-office-el-poblado-medellin.descripcion_corta: Office with floor-to-ceiling windows and views of the greenery, exposed concrete ceilings, wood flooring and an illuminated bookcase, across from Mall del Este.

villa-marina-de-baru-cartagena.titulo: Villa at Marina de Barú — Cartagena
villa-marina-de-baru-cartagena.descripcion_corta: Canal-front villa surrounded by mangroves and green areas. It has a pool, a dock and a thatched-roof palapa.

la-clarita.descripcion_corta: Two-story house with a porch and green yard, on a fenced lot with an entrance gate and parking.

la-ponderosa.descripcion_corta: Country house with white walls and a tile roof, a porch, trees and plenty of room to park.
